overview: Before you went out you looked at Monday's page and added nothing. The messenger was still a mark. You did not begin the prison, the garden, or the end. The chronicle stayed shut.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the old mark and left it.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Looked at the king's page and stopped
